specimen_fe_13.lore: Developed as part of a new mutant generation, dedicated to exploring and colonizing the space beyond the solar system, this mutant expressed its passion for music in addition to its terraforming abilities. It's able to take advantage of the differences in atmospheric characteristics to make its music change and adapt its terraforming methods.

specimen_ff_13.name: Sakuraboshi
specimen_ff_13.lore: Born of a long tradition of pacifist monks, this human-like mutant is actually an incarnation of the cherry blossom kami, marking the beginning of spring in the land of the rising sun. He will never fight directly, and always prefers the refusal of direct confrontation. Which seems to harm the other mutants created for combat...

specimen_a_13.name: Asimov
specimen_a_13.lore: This robot, created following the famous Laws of Robotics, has proven to be too dangerous to keep its standard abilities, allowing him to interact with humans. Indeed, its ability to interpretate the Zeroth Law led it to overreact facing minor risks, and in that sense, cause numerous victims.

specimen_b_13.name: GAR, Zombie Sovereign
specimen_b_13.lore: This extremely powerful zombie is the result of a fundamental research on mutagenic viruses, followed by a pseudo-natural evolution following battles against a series of famous zombie killers. The battles this mutant was exposed to brought it so close to destruction that its regeneration ability has drastically improved. It installed its throne in an abandoned mall, in the middle of a desert.

specimen_c_13.name: D'Arathomis
specimen_c_13.lore: Planning for a worldwide historical broadcast, a group of French scientists tried to create the best mutant equivalent to a French musketeer from the 17th century. They managed to take advantage to acquire DNA fragments from real, long-dead royal musketeers, and combined the genes governing learning ability, loyalty and martial skill, to create the ULTIMATE musketeer mutant !

specimen_d_13.name: Sasquatch
specimen_d_13.lore:
The first mutant ever? Highly unprobable, but this forestbound cryptid, discovered in North American forests implies there might existe numerous natural mutants on Earth... If we search thouroughly. 

 [Redacted]'s research diary.

specimen_e_13.name: Stargazer
specimen_e_13.lore: A star-born creature, this mutant has been discovered when DNA strands have been recovered while doing research on an interstellar comet.

specimen_f_13.name: Väinämöinen
specimen_f_13.lore: This old man with the long beard may not look like much at first glance, but he is an absolute master of kantele and mystical songs. Initially lulled by the poetic and magical songs on his own journey, he has carried on the tradition, ensuring that the musical mysticism lives on in the fjords of the far north. Beware if you challenge him to a singing duel, for he will not do you any favors, and may well hurt you if your voice is not up to par.

specimen_aa_99.name: A00-C0R3-C0NTR0L
specimen_aa_99.lore: This artificial intelligence, initially developed as a control system for A027441 central matrix, has become sentient, due to A027441's multiple interactions in the arena. It then wished to further discover the world, provoking multiple catastrophies as a result.

specimen_ab_99.name: Battle Simulacrum
specimen_ab_99.lore: An organo-mechanic creature from a distant universe. It seems the genetic data for that creature have been retrieved during an energy transfer through dimensional portals.

specimen_ae_99.name: Randonymous
specimen_ae_99.lore: This strange, shape-shifting creature was created to sow discord during Mutenstein's political rally. Despite its ability to change shape based on photos, all its copies contain subtle errors, virtually undetectable except to the trained eye. Probably because her copying system is based on an AI model created in a dimension where beings have fewer fingers...

specimen_af_99.name: A027441
specimen_af_99.lore: A027441 is not a human creation. It is an artificial intelligence that wanted to incarnate in the real world. After complex calculations to optimize the space and the necessary energy, it created this avatar by taking control of a chain of production ... which no one has any news ...

specimen_bd_99.name: Tengu
specimen_bd_99.lore: Psy Captain, your sponsors have been really impressed by your will! Breeding all of these mutants has not been an easy adventure! Darwin is proud to offer you one of the most unique and his favorite specimen: Tengu! This demon has an infinite knowledge of the martial arts and is also the protective spirit of the arena. Your enemies will learn to fear its destructive combo!

specimen_ca_99.name: Awakened Missy
specimen_ca_99.lore: After her last vacation, Missy was "activated" by Mutenstein, who took the opportunity to grant her new talents and equipment. He probably intends to use this new form of Missy as a tool to control public opinion and to spread his eugenicist theses on the world... Fortunately, Missy was able to regain a more human appearance and limit her destructive abilities to acceptable values. This mutant has cyber and galactic attacks.

specimen_ce_99.name: Kolossus
specimen_ce_99.lore: Kolossus is one of the most powerful of all mutants. In a world of peace, his appetite for war is now seated in the arena.

specimen_cf_99.name: True Hero Reed
specimen_cf_99.lore: Driven by a mixture of admiration, jealousy, wonder and resentment of the Psy-Captains, Reed set out to become the story's one and only hero, altering reality with complex alien devices. How did he manage to make them work so fast? Reed may be vain, but he's no less brilliant... Provided he has a real goal in mind.

specimen_df_99.name: Genimal
specimen_df_99.lore:
Genimal, gotta kill them all
Its you and me, I know it’s my destiny
Genimal, oh, you're my best treat
In a world we must defeat!

specimen_ea_99.name: Celsius Thermoid
specimen_ea_99.lore: This exclusive mutant has been created especially for the 20th anniversary of Celsius Online. Its characteristic green color appears when it is in its normal state, and changes to orange or blue when it is about to attack with its thermal attacks.

specimen_eb_99.name: Diablo
specimen_eb_99.lore: Imprisoned for 200 years in a soulstone, Diablo was released in Genetic City by Urban, with the sole purpose of causing chaos. However, the forces that Urban unleashed were far more dangerous than he had anticipated, and the demon that he invoked annihilated both his armies and his enemies.

specimen_ee_99.name: Irreality Animus
specimen_ee_99.lore:
When you combine Antimatter with normal matter, do you know what it makes? Nothing! Absolutely nothing! Both are disintegrated into nothingness… And that’s what makes this mutant so dangerous. 
It comes from a region of the universe, where reality started to reverse itself: good people becoming evil, darkness becoming light… But someone thought it was a good idea to harness that reality-reversing effect, and turn it into a weapon to attack Earth. Will you manage to save the planet, or will you be consumed by the Antimatter?

specimen_ef_99.name: Singularity Wizard
specimen_ef_99.lore:
Prof. ... - Experiment Log

January 15 - ... particle accelerator ... first tests ... evolution ... Mutant ...

March 12 - ... setback. ... Galactic DNA ... combine ...

June 2 - ... reactions ... evolution ... humanity ...

August 7 - ...  happy ... Singularity Wizard ... out of my control ... Let's go back to work on the experiments.

specimen_fa_99.name: Archangel
specimen_fa_99.lore: Although Eva ended her career as Psy Captain, she has always kept an eye on the arena. Concerned that Urban's evolution would bring nothing good, she decided to design her own personal mutant. Woe to those who would do harm to Eva and her friends, the Archangel will let no-one threaten her mistress!

specimen_fc_99.name: Nimrod
specimen_fc_99.lore:
Escaped from another dimension, Nimrod is a powerful mutant which was once a king and the builder of a powerful empire. Death means nothing for Nimrod and nothing will stop him in his quest to restore his former empire.
 
- Free mutant obtained by defeating Nimrod in Celsius Heroes -

specimen_fe_99.name: Engineer
specimen_fe_99.lore: Engineers are strange creatures. They probably created human kind millions of years ago, but they also created the Xenomorphs, one of Humanity's worst enemies. Some say they are Gods. However they can be seen fighting regular Mutants.

specimen_ff_99.name: Emotional Maskerade
specimen_ff_99.lore: In all circumstances, everyone wears a mask. The mask of their own existence and their own reality. When the mask becomes reality, we become actors in our own existence. And when the masks all come to life together, reality is turned upside down. The true origin of this mutant is unknown; all analyses seem to fail to determine its precise origin, as if its existence were being called into question.

specimen_ab_14.name: The Screencaster
specimen_ab_14.lore: In the underground world, there are many Necro mutants with functions similar to those on the surface. Among them are damaged objects possessed by disturbed spirits, attempting to revive the memory of these objects' past. This possessed television set has managed to build its own underground media empire and regularly kidnaps people from the surface to have guests on its variety show.

specimen_ac_14.name: Professor Chronomantik
specimen_ac_14.lore: This former history teacher, lost in time following a time machine accident, found himself propelled through various eras, during which he was able to build his famous ink cannon and adapt it to locally available elements. However, his time-travel abilities have been limited by the size of his mutation, and traces of his passage remain in multiple eras.

specimen_ad_14.name: Origamix
specimen_ad_14.lore: This strange creature is made of paper, both literally and figuratively. It was born from the strong will of a master origami artist who had created numerous works and poured all his creativity into one final project: a living fold capable of taking on multiple forms. Be careful, though—it's easy to cut yourself with so much paper!

specimen_ae_14.name: Giganto-Moai
specimen_ae_14.lore: This specimen discovered on Easter Island is more of an organometallic life form than a simple robot. What civilization could have put them there, and when? These are just some of the questions that trouble Mutenstein, who seems to be hiding a great deal from us...

specimen_af_14.name: Black I.C.E.
specimen_af_14.lore: This extremely advanced security system is programmed to injure or even kill intruders in computer systems, unlike many other systems which seek only to protect or expel. Initially reserved for entities purely made up of data on the network, the application of the program to a mutant with advanced combat capabilities has revolutionized the world of space security. However, it can sometimes be a little too dangerous and lethal...

specimen_ba_14.name: Mecargoyle
specimen_ba_14.lore: For centuries, it has waited patiently atop ancient buildings. The passage of time has damaged many of its stone parts, which have gradually been replaced with modernized metal versions, such as its claws and wings. And now it has finally awakened to the world, watching motionless from the rooftops, ready to pounce brutally on unsuspecting prey.

specimen_bc_14.name: Perfitrouille
specimen_bc_14.lore: A treacherous spirit born from a pumpkin seed. This embodiment of Trick or Treats imitates childish behaviour at Halloween time to collect candy and and make cruel (and sometimes deadly) pranks at the expense of all others... Don't fall for its childish smile, this mutant could very well make your life a real nightmare.

specimen_bd_14.name: Greensward Rager
specimen_bd_14.lore: An undead zooanthropic horror, inadvertently created during experiments to try and eradicate myxomatosis once and for all. The disease was effectively eradicated, but it had unforeseen effects on some of the infected rabbits, mutating some of them into monstrosities capable of ravaging an entire field overnight.

specimen_ca_14.name: Breakmaster
specimen_ca_14.lore:
Step up to the beat. 
Never take a hit. 
Dance along with it. 
Prove you’re an athlete. 

This was the motto of the scientific team who tried to make the first dancing and battling mutant ever. The rhymes permeated their work so deeply that it led them to a breakdancing mutant, using its capabilities to fight in unseen ways in the Arena.

specimen_cb_14.name: Fleet Captain Blackbeard
specimen_cb_14.lore: The most famous of all freebooters has been regenerated in an idealized version of the Caribbean, where he is now the greatest pirate in the universe... Can you steal his title and become the Lord of Plunder?

specimen_cc_14.name: Blue King
specimen_cc_14.lore: This lazy king is accustomed to betrayal and backroom assassinations. In order to never be defeated by his enemies, he has developed methods that allow him to fight directly from his throne. He has even developed means of teleportation to both hide and strike his opponents from behind.

specimen_cd_14.name: Don Gamberetti
specimen_cd_14.lore: Since the rediscovery of Neo-Atlantis and the construction of underwater arenas for thrill-seeking audiences, underwater exploration has developed significantly. And as in many large cities, organized crime has left its mark on this underwater city. This mutant is the embodiment of this, the leader of the largest mafia on the seabed, despite his modest origins near the Sicilian coast. Armed with an automatic machine gun in one of his claws, he was able to dethrone all the other lieutenants of the previous Don, whether they were pistol shrimp or octopus wrestlers. Now he runs his criminal empire with an iron claw from his 1920s-style bar.

specimen_cf_14.name: Ice Dancer Yria
specimen_cf_14.lore: In order to combat gratuitous violence, a European team based around the Baltic Sea developed a mutant dedicated to figure skating. However, the latter's fighting instincts ultimately proved to be more important than his natural grace and ability to perform tricks. So it was simply that Yria ended up in the arenas of Genetic City despite the destiny that was promised to him.

specimen_da_14.name: B.U.N. Overmind
specimen_da_14.lore: This cybernetic unit directs all B.U.N. Tower operations from its top floor. No information is available on the particulars of the acronym B.U.N.

specimen_db_14.name: The Crawling Madness
specimen_db_14.lore: A crawling horror of unknown origin, blending characteristics of arachnids, scorpions, scolopendras and other arthropod predators. Its venom is lethal even at very low doses, but acts particularly slowly, causing horrible pain and agony that can last for days. An antidote is currently being developed, but its success rate remains below 30% for the time being. Who is the mad scientist who developed this creature and released it in Genetic City? The mystery still remains...

specimen_dc_14.name: Jurassic Terror
specimen_dc_14.lore: This dinosaur monster, covered in spikes and blades, is the fruit of research carried out by various laboratories into new forms of fighting dinosaurs, designed specifically for the arena. Some would say that this particular form was revealed by a multiversal creature. Watch out for the bleeding!

specimen_dd_14.name: Bestial Overlord
specimen_dd_14.lore: Numerous cryptids have been created over the course of time, most through failed genetic manipulation. One laboratory, however, succeeded in combining top predators from continents, skies, oceans and the past. Their research data was sent to Genetic City University for replication, but when an award was due to be presented, none of the project's participants gave any sign of life...

specimen_de_14.name: Supermassive Infinity
specimen_de_14.lore: This three-headed space serpent, classified in the Ouroboros family, is capable of modifying its density and synchronizing its three bodies to generate spectacular accelerations or points of infinite density. Its relative mass could not be correctly estimated, as in most cases the subject fled during the observation.

specimen_ea_14.name: D.A.B.
specimen_ea_14.lore: After extensive research by a large banking consortium to make ATMs more welcoming and user-friendly, in order to boost user confidence and prevent hacking attempts, a number of incidents occurred involving customers who were rather annoyed by the machines' AI. Wishing to cover up the affair, the consortium blamed the machine's creators and reused their concept to develop a mutant that directly attacks its opponents with raw gold bars.

specimen_ed_14.name: Hydrydra
specimen_ed_14.lore: This sea monster seems to be made almost entirely of water, making it particularly resistant to direct attack. According to various sources, its multi-headed shape enables it to attack in all directions and to constantly monitor its surroundings, preventing it from being taken by surprise.

specimen_ef_14.name: K'Yu T'ypaï
specimen_ef_14.lore: This creature of extraterrestrial origin, apparently escaped from one of Mutenstein's laboratories, has, according to him, the ability to transform all other creatures into cute things. Why would Mutenstein have such a creature if he hates cuteness so much?

specimen_fb_14.name: Zagam, Great King of Greed
specimen_fb_14.lore: This sinister demon, President and King of a huge part of the underworld, is said to be capable of transforming any metal into usable currency... And he is very generous with those who make a pact with him... But demonic pacts are far from without consequences...

specimen_fd_14.name: Vanir Queen Freyja
specimen_fd_14.lore: As part of an exploration commissioned by Mutenstein, Eva and Urban arrived in a dimension and temporality close to the Viking era, but ruled by deity-bound mutants. After defeating it, some archaeological treasures were brought back by the group in order to study Viking civilization in detail beyond the known residual texts, and they were able to recover fragments of this mutant's DNA from these artifacts so they could verify the nature of these mutants.

specimen_fe_14.name: Seraphic Core
specimen_fe_14.lore: A strange creature emanating a powerful light, the mere sight of which has driven mad some of the scientists who have tried to study it. Only Psy-Captains with minds of steel dare attempt to dominate this mutant, and most often with great effort.

specimen_ff_14.name: Twilight Prophet
specimen_ff_14.lore: An extremely powerful mystical entity from a dimension where magic reigns supreme. The Prophetess travels worlds and dimensions to spread mysticism and overwhelm all dimensions with a flood of unparalleled mystical power, regardless of the impact on the inhabitants of those dimensions.

specimen_a_14.name: Automaton
specimen_a_14.lore: This entirely mechanical artificial creature has been reformulated by studying works from the end of the 2nd millennium, while adding modern energy sources to enable it to have infinite autonomy, beyond even the survival of our technological civilizations.

specimen_b_14.name: Spectroplasm
specimen_b_14.lore: This ectoplasmic entity is particularly unstable. Created as simple cells during the study of ectoplasmic fluids, it continued to evolve until it reached full consciousness. Capable of possessing other mutants and generating powerful ectoplasmic explosions, the entity has been confined to use in arenas to avoid further major problems related to the possession of mutants.

specimen_c_14.name: Gladiator
specimen_c_14.lore: What would an arena be without gladiators? Not much, according to some researchers in Roman history, who have recovered genetic fragments from several famous gladiators of the Roman era to create a true champion, ready to die under the shouts of the boisterous crowd!

specimen_f_14.name: Magician
specimen_f_14.lore: This little creature has powerful magical abilities, but they are not unlimited. Fortunately, it has learned to do without magic and throw its spellbook at enemies with devastating force. Don't let it catch you off guard!

specimen_ab_15.name: Glitchy Heart
specimen_ab_15.lore: A final boss from an old video game, found by Darwin, who has taken root in reality following some rather dubious connections. He has reflexes and ways of doing things very similar to those of bosses from days gone by: kidnapping princesses, creating massive complexes with elevators several kilometers high... All this to be defeated by heroes of exceptional courage.

specimen_de_15.name: Telluric Starweaver
specimen_de_15.lore: This mutant with druidic characteristics came into possession of a strange staff made of meteorite materials that had traveled across the galaxy. Thanks to this technologically advanced object, he was able to manipulate stars and constellations beyond human comprehension. Unfortunately, what he didn't know was that by doing so, he would affect reality by altering the very structure of our universe to create mutants based on these stars.

specimen_e_14.name: Spiraxia
specimen_e_14.lore: The raw power of the stars, condensed into a humanoid form capable of interacting with the rest of the universe. That was the mandate given to the scientists and astronomers who designed this mutant using data from radio telescopes around the world. And the results have exceeded their expectations in many ways. What will happen once it is propelled into the arenas of Genetic City?

specimen_bf_14.name: Irradiance
specimen_bf_14.lore: An entity with power comparable to that of a god, sealed for centuries in a stained glass window, radiating power and light. The stained glass window was freed during the renovation of a cathedral, allowing this entity to escape, before being recaptured and forced to fight in the arenas of Genetic City. Do not succumb to its honeyed promises; the only thing it will offer you if you help it is a painful death.

specimen_ce_14.name: Cosmic Dandy
specimen_ce_14.lore: Preferring the comfort of luxury hotels on the most exotic planets, this alien spends most of his time relaxing and playing cosmic variations of billiards. Be careful, though—like any true gentleman, he has learned many ways to fight using objects around him.

specimen_be_15.name: The Hunger
specimen_be_15.lore: A massive creature composed of chocolate elements that form the very structure of the Chocoworld. The reasons for its appearance are still unknown, but it seems to operate on the same principle as black holes: once a critical mass of chocolate is reached, an entity appears to devour it relentlessly, leading to the probable destruction of any world made of chocolate.

specimen_ea_15.name: Kereon of the Abyss
specimen_ea_15.lore: An autonomous robotic unit created by a brilliant inventor centuries ago to explore the deep sea. Forgotten for hundreds of years, this robot—which is impervious to external corrosion thanks to its fluid systems—has tirelessly explored the ocean floor, but its programming has deteriorated, and it now attacks any creature that enters its exploration territory.

specimen_d_14.name: Apiarchia
specimen_d_14.lore: Every hive has a queen, and she is deeply connected to her swarm. Once a simple worker bee who became queen following an industrial accident, she has taken the fate of her hive into her own hands, leading it into battle.

specimen_dd_15.name: Platypus
specimen_dd_15.lore: Over the past four centuries, many scientists have pondered the nature of this strange creature: a true animal, a living chimera, an altered being, or, more recently, a mutant? A consensus was eventually reached, and the scientific community delivered a final verdict: it is a mutant, with all the advantages and disadvantages that entails. But a mutant that has long been adapted to terrestrial ecosystems—a fact that has raised many doubts.

specimen_aa_14.name: Arbitrator
specimen_aa_14.lore: Originally developed in the 2200s by a man named Raymond Ferey, this referee robot was programmed with a personality combining data from the most famous referees of the 20th and 21st centuries. This explosive combination made him particularly unstable, and following multiple accidents in stadiums, he was shelved for over 60 years. Initially envisioned as a referee for mutant fights, his explosive personality and natural violence ultimately relegated him to the role of a fighter.

specimen_fc_14.name: Vulcan
specimen_fc_14.lore: Ancient Roman myths spoke of two deities, one of the forge and the other of volcanoes. But were they truly distinct, or merely two aspects of a single entity, capable of both triggering the eruption of Vesuvius and forging legendary weapons? Science settled the question several millennia later by recreating this volatile, volcanic mutant….

specimen_fa_14.name: Fractal Hexcaster
specimen_fa_14.lore: A strange creature from Hex City. It appears to manipulate both aspects of the local magic, projecting luminous hexagons and fractal explosions. Its role in the events unfolding there remains unclear. But its interest in discovering other dimensions makes it a perfect mutant for the arenas of Genetic City.

specimen_ef_15.name: Geo-Diamond
specimen_ef_15.lore: A strange entity that fell to Earth millions of years ago, crystallized within a geode of pure diamond. This alien creature has fused its energy with that of the surrounding crystals to take on a physical form, but this in no way prevents it from using its natural ability to produce powerful beams of energy.

specimen_fa_15.name: Majicka, Arithmancy Queen
specimen_fa_15.lore: The ruler of Hex City. Her attire constantly reflects the infinite fractals, and her equipment mirrors the arithmantical structures that govern the dimensional zone where she resides. She was responsible for the banishment of a certain individual, but that individual’s influence still lingers across multiple dimensions.
